content: ESP32-S3 has a dedicated LCD_CAM peripheral with GDMA supporting a standard 24-pin DVP camera interface (PCLK/XCLK/HREF/VSYNC + D0-D9 data lines), compatible with OV5640/OV3660/OV2640/GC0308/GC2145 via the esp32-camera component. OV5640 tops out at 15fps at full 5MP due to bandwidth, but does 720p@60fps — for a handheld photo app, capturing at reduced resolution/JPEG is the practical mode. DVP does not support multiple simultaneous cameras (not relevant here, single camera).
